rounds.notes:
[Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) and [Attack Speed](stat_attack_speed) synergize so well with Mercy's kit, so I feel I do her a disservice by not leaning into it with  [Compensator](item_2a354f80-610c-4661-9bdd-8960ae1a60b0) and  [Weapon Grease](item_961ae72f-434f-406b-a89b-ab8efec806bf) 

Take [Armored Vest](item_358361e2-59be-4c81-b221-8a87f37809e6) against [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power).

Take [First Aid Kit](item_0172eaaa-1902-44a3-b989-d12f0f7301da) against [Ability Power](stat_ability_power).

## **Playstyle:**
Play Mercy as usual. Watch your angles and keep your beam constantly active. Focus healing for easy cash and ult charge, but keep in mind to use your damage boost whenever your healing isn't needed. I aim for a 60%/40% split, personally, but so long as your team is alive and enabled by you you're set.

round_upgrades.notes: Hands down the absolute best first power for Mercy. Keep the beam juggled between your allies and you'll gain constant ult charge and cash, both extremely important for this build.

## **$10,000**
Buy [Advanced Nanobiotics](item_26fcf7c9-b81a-4d8e-a459-b515519cb73e) and either [Aftermarket Firing Pin](item_2485b212-b286-42d0-a2bd-20eb4396b054) or [Icy Coolant](item_8b1c21e9-33e8-49a6-8277-a3a06d55a65f), and any other [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) or [Attack Speed](stat_attack_speed) Blue or Green items you can buy with your remaining cash.

## **Under $10,000**
Try to buy as many recommended Blue items as you can, prioritizing [Advanced Nanobiotics](item_26fcf7c9-b81a-4d8e-a459-b515519cb73e). If you still cannot afford Blue items, buy as many [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) and Survival Green items as you can.

## **Struggling to survive?**
If you find yourself getting gunned down by a [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) character such as [Cassidy](hero_3dd63854-7558-4344-86e4-b506f807129b),  [Soldier: 76](hero_e1ac7ef5-4648-4998-b8b0-9e3da3e60546), or [Ashe](hero_37b42a2d-a82d-4a22-9df2-4c812c873b54), take [Iron Eyes](item_f16d03a7-f20e-4a1d-a1f6-55863e163c03) and/or [Vital-E-Tee](item_b92e6f1d-3aac-4eec-b027-00c8e1529016) instead of one of the Blues recommended earlier.

Meanwhile, if an [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) hero such as a torpedo [Juno](hero_035c63b7-084c-4abd-9de5-c9a00e9b6a18), dynamite [Ashe](hero_37b42a2d-a82d-4a22-9df2-4c812c873b54), or orb [Moira](hero_7fb6ff1e-a193-40c0-bd0a-25c1928fbaed) is the problem, go for [Crusader Hydraulics](item_b64cee07-ca32-405d-987e-868b415bbc09) and/or [Reinforced Titanium](item_8ebaa7db-aedf-48ed-adc1-318cb46a3214)

## **Playstyle:**
Adjust your playstyle according to whether you won or lost. 

If you won, keep going as you were last round. Just make sure you aren't getting over-confident and keep playing smart and safe.

If you lost or feel targeted, play corners and stay safe. If you're a flighty Mercy like I am, contemplate keeping grounded for now until you've got some confidence in being able to stay alive. Keep in mind that your beam stays attached through walls for a couple seconds, so don't be afraid to break LOS if you need a quick break.

## **$20,000**
Buy [Amari's Antidote](item_67e0b1c5-3bcb-4ab5-b818-5082e5706124), and any Blue and Green items you can afford. Prioritize [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) and [Attack Speed](stat_attack_speed).

## **Under $20,000**
Sell [Compensator](item_2a354f80-610c-4661-9bdd-8960ae1a60b0) as well and try to catch up on any Blue items you may have missed before. [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power), [Attack Speed](stat_attack_speed), and Survival are all things you cannot go wrong with.

## **Chain Evoker: Is it worth it?**
I personally prioritize heals over damage boost so I do not get much use out of this item, but if you are a blue beam mercy this could help you stack up that sweet, sweet ult charge just a little easier. It's not the best use of cash in my opinion, but I can imagine it having a purpose in the right hands. Now would be the time to grab it if you want it.

## **Playstyle:**
No matter what, keep playing smart and safe. You can't help your team if you're dead, so prioritize your safety so you can guarantee theirs.

Keep playing as you normally would. Focus heals, juggle your beam to keep [Threads of Fate](item_cb61612b-9d83-49a9-989d-013bf084fbcb) active, and watch that sweet cash roll in.

Now that you have a better chance at a successful resurrection, do your best to time your resurrection's to happen before or after you valkyrie and vice versa to get those nice 20s Valk's, but don't sweat it if the timing doesn't work out. Just do your best to keep yourself and your team alive.

## **$60,000**
Sell [Icy Coolant](item_8b1c21e9-33e8-49a6-8277-a3a06d55a65f) and buy [Iridescent Iris](item_b7fb28ef-ce82-416b-8693-01c274f8df4e). You're gonna need that added ability power to really make [First Responder](item_30a5c70f-e0b5-489a-96ae-900f34c3823d) a powerful pick. Not to mention the overhealth when you ult will make your Valk's just that much more viable and keep you out of many sticky situations! It even activates when you proc Renaissance!

## **Under $60,000**
I fear I'm gonna have to say what I've said every other round. Buy what you can and godspeed my friend.

## **Playstyle:**
You should be the true unkillable moth you came here to be. You've gotten your bag, but those pesky enemies are still fighting strong. Rez and Valk whenever you can, watch your angles, and as always, keep yourself alive to keep your team alive.

Good luck!!!!
